description: Any authenticated user can read or update any document by sequential ID; ownership is never checked.
Checkout trusts client-supplied price/total instead of recalculating from a server catalog.
Single-use coupon uses non-atomic check-then-act; concurrent redeem can succeed more than once.
Refund approve can be called without prior /api/refund/request and without staff role or auth.
Free-tier limit of 3 projects is documented for the UI only; server accepts unlimited creates.
